Good day, and welcome to the InnovateCloud Q1 2024 Earnings Conference Call. All participants are in listen-only mode. After the speakers' presentation, there will be a question and answer session. [Operator Instructions] Please be advised that today's call is being recorded.

I would now like to turn the call over to John Smith, VP of Investor Relations. Please go ahead.

John Smith:
Thank you, Operator. Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to InnovateCloud's Q1 earnings call. Joining me today are Alex Johnson, CEO; Sarah Chen, CFO; David Lee, CTO; and Emily Carter, Chief Revenue Officer.

Before we begin, I'd like to remind you that this call contains forward-looking statements. Actual results may differ materially. Please refer to our SEC filings for a complete discussion of risks and uncertainties.

Now, I'll turn the call over to Alex Johnson.

Alex Johnson:
Thank you, John, and good afternoon, everyone. I'm pleased to report on InnovateCloud's performance for Q1. We achieved significant milestones this quarter, driven by strong demand for our SynergyCRM and continued execution of our strategic initiatives.

Our focus this quarter was on five key areas: ARR growth, operating expense management, next quarter ARR guidance, churn analysis, and average contract value trends.

Sarah will be providing a detailed update on ARR growth, but I want to highlight that our ARR at the end of Q1 2024 reached $425 million, representing a robust 35% year-over-year growth. This strong performance reflects the continued demand for our unified cloud platform, particularly in the areas of AI-powered analytics and cybersecurity solutions.

We are carefully managing our operating expenses to ensure we are investing in the right areas to drive growth and profitability. This includes balancing investments in R&D, Sales & Marketing, and G&A. Sarah will provide a detailed breakdown shortly.

Looking ahead to Q2, we are projecting ARR to reach approximately $459 million, representing a QoQ growth of around 8%. We are cautiously optimistic about the remainder of the year, but we are also mindful of the uncertain macroeconomic environment.

We are closely monitoring customer churn and implementing strategies to mitigate its impact. This includes enhanced customer onboarding programs, product enhancements, and pricing optimization.

Finally, we are focused on increasing our average contract value by upselling and cross-selling our products and solutions. We are seeing success with our premium Enterprise Security Suite add-on, which is driving higher contract values.

We are confident in our ability to continue this momentum and deliver long-term value to our shareholders.

Now, I'll turn the call over to Sarah Chen to discuss the financials in more detail.

Sarah Chen:
Thank you, Alex. As Alex mentioned, we had a strong quarter. Let's dive straight into ARR. Our ARR at the end of Q1 2024 reached $425 million. This represents a robust 35% YoY growth compared to our ARR of $315 million at the end of Q1 2023. Sequentially, we saw an 8% QoQ growth compared to our $393.5 million ARR at the end of Q4 2023. Several factors contributed to this strong ARR performance, including our AI-powered analytics module, InsightAI, which accounted for approximately 20% of our new ARR. We also successfully integrated and launched the FortressGuard suite, a comprehensive cybersecurity solution, within our platform. This product contributed approximately 15% to new ARR. Also, our revamped partner program, InnovateCloud Alliance, has proven effective in expanding our reach. Partner-influenced ARR grew by 40% YoY.

Now, let's dive into the operating expense breakdown for Q3 2024. Operating expenses for Q3 2024 totaled $125 million, representing 65% of our $192 million in revenue. This compares to $95 million or 60% of revenue in Q3 2023. R&D spending continues to increase, reflecting our commitment to maintaining a technological edge. In Q3 2024, it was $40 million, or 20.8% of revenue. S&M expenses have increased proportionally with revenue growth, amounting to $65 million or 33.9% of revenue. This is primarily driven by our expansion into new markets and our focus on acquiring larger enterprise accounts. G&A expenses have increased, but at a slower rate than revenue, reaching $20 million or 10.4% of revenue.

We are projecting ARR to reach between $412 million and $416 million by the end of Q3 2024. This represents a sequential increase of approximately $28 million - $32 million from the $384 million we reported for Q2, and translates to a projected growth of 7.3% to 8.3% quarter-over-quarter. This guidance is built on the assumption ShieldGuard will contribute approximately 45% of net new ARR in Q3, and expansion revenue from SynergyCRM is projected to contribute around 30% of the net new ARR. We are projecting a gross dollar retention rate of 92% and a net dollar retention rate of 115% for Q3.

As part of this earnings call, I want to provide a detailed update on our customer churn and the strategies we're implementing to address it. Overall Gross Dollar Retention is currently at 92%, and our annual logo churn rate is currently at 7%. The SMB segment experiences the highest churn, currently at 9%, driven by budget constraints and limited IT resources. Our enterprise churn remains the lowest at 2%, with mergers and acquisitions being the primary driver. We are implementing a "Quick Start" program tailored for SMBs, investing in more personalized onboarding for mid-market, accelerating development of advanced analytics and workflow automation capabilities, and evaluating introducing a more affordable entry-level tier for SMBs.

In Q3 2024, our ACV landed at $85,000, marking a 7% increase year-over-year compared to Q3 2023's $79,500. Upselling and cross-selling, especially with our Enterprise Security Suite, continues to be a significant driver. We are also increasingly targeting larger enterprise clients. To drive further ACV growth, we are actively working on creating more compelling product bundles, investing in AI-powered tools to improve the effectiveness of our sales team, and expanding our customer success team. We anticipate ACV to reach $88,000 in Q4 2024, representing a 10% year-over-year growth.

We continue to invest in research and development to drive innovation and expand our product offerings. Our cash position remains strong, providing us with the flexibility to pursue strategic acquisitions and other growth opportunities.

We are updating our full-year guidance to reflect our strong performance in the first half of the year. We now expect revenue to be in the range of $780 million to $800 million.

Now, I'll turn the call over to David Lee for a technology update.

David Lee:
Thank you, Sarah. This quarter, we made significant progress in advancing our AI capabilities and further integrating them into our core platform. We are seeing strong adoption of our new AI-powered features, which are driving increased user engagement and improved customer outcomes. Specifically, our AI-Powered Campaign Optimizer has shown a 15% improvement in campaign conversion rates in early trials. We've also focused on enhancing our platform's security and scalability to meet the growing demands of our enterprise customers. We are in the process of migrating our core platform to a microservices architecture on AWS. This is a multi-year project, but it will significantly improve scalability, resilience, and developer velocity. We are continuously enhancing our security measures to protect our customers' data and ensure compliance with industry regulations. Finally, we've released new and improved developer APIs to make it easier for our customers and partners to integrate their applications with our platform. In Q2 we began migrating our infrastructure to a more scalable and resilient architecture based on Kubernetes, which will improve the performance and reliability of our services. We've invested heavily in threat detection and prevention capabilities, which has helped us to win larger enterprise deals, notably in the healthcare vertical. We've implemented advanced data analytics tools that provide us with real-time insights into customer usage patterns and product performance, allowing us to optimize our product development roadmap and tailor our sales and marketing efforts for maximum effectiveness. Enhanced Usage Tracking helps us to better understand how customers are using our platform and identify areas where they may be struggling. We are using tools like Mixpanel and Amplitude for this. We are focused on improving error handling and providing more informative error messages to help customers resolve issues quickly. We are deploying an AI-powered chatbot to provide instant support and answer common questions, reducing the burden on our support team and improving customer satisfaction. We are embedding in-app guidance and tooltips to help customers navigate the platform and discover new features.

Now, I'll turn the call back to the operator for Q&A.

Operator:
Thank you. [Operator Instructions] Our first question comes from Michael Brown with Goldman Sachs.

Michael Brown:
Hi, good afternoon. Can you discuss the impact of SynergyCRM on your overall growth, and what kind of attach rates are you seeing with it?

Emily Carter:
SynergyCRM continues to be a cornerstone of our growth strategy, serving as the entry point for many new customers and providing a platform for expansion. We're seeing a significant uptick in attach rates for our AI-powered modules, particularly the sales forecasting and marketing automation tools. Approximately 40% of new SynergyCRM customers are adding at least one of these modules within the first quarter, demonstrating the value they see in leveraging AI to improve their sales and marketing performance. We're also seeing strong adoption of SynergyCRM within specific verticals, such as healthcare and financial services, where our compliance features and security measures resonate particularly well.

Operator:
Our next question comes from Lisa Wong with Morgan Stanley.

Lisa Wong:
What are your plans for international expansion, specifically in the APAC region?

Alex Johnson:
We are very excited about the opportunities in the APAC region. We recently launched a new regional sales office in Singapore, and we are seeing positive traction in the market. Our strategy in APAC is focused on building strong partnerships with local system integrators and managed service providers. We are also investing in localizing our platform to support local languages and currencies. We are initially targeting key markets like Australia, Singapore, and India, and we plan to expand our presence further as we gain traction. We believe that APAC will be a significant growth driver for us in the coming years. We are adapting our platform to support local languages and currencies, complying with local data privacy regulations, and building relationships with local partners.

Operator:
Our next question comes from David Miller with Oppenheimer.

David Miller:
How are you managing churn in the current economic environment, and what's the trend you are seeing in NRR?

Sarah Chen:
We are proactively managing churn through a combination of enhanced customer onboarding programs, product enhancements, and pricing optimization. We are closely monitoring our churn rates across different customer segments and geographies, and we are tailoring our strategies accordingly. As previously mentioned, we're implementing a "Quick Start" program tailored for SMBs and investing in more personalized onboarding for mid-market clients. We are also accelerating development of advanced analytics and workflow automation capabilities. Despite some macroeconomic headwinds, we are pleased to report that our net dollar retention rate remains strong at 115%, showcasing our effective upsell and cross-sell strategies outweighing churn impact on revenue.

Operator:
Thank you. I'm showing no further questions at this time. I'd like to turn the call back over to Alex Johnson for closing remarks.

Alex Johnson:
Thank you for joining us today. We are pleased with our progress this quarter and remain committed to delivering strong results for our shareholders. We look forward to speaking with you again on our next earnings call.

Operator:
Thank you for your participation. You may now disconnect.
